bug_report_content:
Title: Beider Morse Phonetic Matching producing incorrect tokens
Type: Bug | Priority: Minor | Status: Closed | Resolution: Fixed

Description:
I believe the Beider Morse Phonetic Matching algorithm was added in Commons Codec 1.6

The BMPM algorithm is an EVOLVING algorithm that is currently on version 3.02 though it had been static since version 3.01 dated 19 Dec 2011 (it was first available as opensource as version 1.00 on 6 May 2009).

I can see nothing in the Commons Codec Docs to say which version of BMPM was implemented so I am not sure if the problem with the algorithm as coded in the Codec is simply an old version or whether there are more basic problems with the implementation.

How do I determine the version of the algorithm that was implemented in the Commons Codec?

How do we ensure that the algorithm is updated if/when the BMPM algorithm changes?

How do we ensure that the algorithm as coded in the Commons Codec is accurate and working as expected?

Comments:

[Gary D. Gregory]: JIRA is not a support forum. Please ask your questions on the user or developer mailing list.

If you have a bug to report, please submit examples of input and output, a unit test would be best.

The principal author of BM code may monitor the ML, where he will hopefully answer your questions.

[michael tobias]: I believe I DID submit a bug report - but it would have made my job much easier had I known the VERSION of the BMPM algorithm programmed into the Commons Codec.

I believe it is also vitally important to have the algorithm version DOCUMENTED.  It is a BUG not to specify the version of an algorithm implemented when that algorithm is not static but is subject to revision.

Here is an example showing the bug in tokens returned:

Using the default nameType="GENERIC" ruleType="APPROX" languageSet="auto" the name "Abram" should produce phonetic tokens as follows:

abram abrom avram avrom obram obrom ovram ovrom Ybram Ybrom abran abron obran obron 

these results for the name Abram have been unchanged since BMPM version 2.0 dated 18 June 2009.

but the BMPM in the Commons Codec returns:

abram abrom avram avrom obram obrom ovram ovrom abran abron obran obron

ie we are missing the 2 tokens:

Ybram Ybrom 

if this one example is wrong then how many others will be?

How much testing was done of the coding?

[Thomas Neidhart]: The problem that you have found is related to some of the rules file (gen_approx_any.txt):

instead of

{noformat}
"A" "" "[^aeiouAEBFIOU]e" "(a|o|Y[$german]|D[$english])" // "plane"
{noformat}

it should be

{noformat}
"A" "" "[^aeiouAEBFIOU]e" "(a|o|Y[german]|D[english])" // "plane"
{noformat}

There are other occurrences of the same error in this file, maybe in others too.
The more serious problem is now that it looks like a 1:1 translation of the original php code from the authors of the algorithm which is released as GPL code. Now, I am not sure if we received permission to include the rules in codec under the Apache license as otherwise we have a real problem here.

[michael tobias]: Thanks Thomas

Whose permission do you need?

If from Steve Morse and Alexander Beider then I am sure the permission was granted.  I can confirm with them both anything that is required.

Regards

Michael
